description: This file implements classes related to AWC (possibly 'Application Window Controller') event notification, including notifier and listener classes, with methods for managing listeners and propagating state change events.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages a list of listeners interested in AWC state changes and notifies them.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Receives notifications about window and state changes, forwarding relevant events to the notifier.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the notifier's list if not already registered.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from the notifier's list.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a state change event.

methods.name: notifyWindowChange
methods.description: Placeholder for window change notifications; currently does nothing.

methods.name: notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications and forwards them to the notifier.

methods.name: notifyServiceReady
methods.description: Placeholder for service ready notification; currently does nothing.
